SPDC Simulation API#

SPDC simulation.

This module provides SPDC_Simulation, which computes the joint spectral amplitude (JSA) and joint spectral intensity (JSI) of photon pairs generated by spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in a nonlinear crystal.

The simulation evaluates: - a pump spectral envelope on a wavelength grid, - a phase-matching function via a longitudinal integral over the poling pattern, - the resulting joint spectral amplitude (complex) and intensity.

Notes

This module is intended to be documented with Sphinx using autodoc + napoleon. Docstrings follow NumPy style.

class photonpairlab.spdc.simulation.SPDC_Simulation(crystal, laser, wavelength_signal=None, wavelength_idler=None, wavelength_signal_range=[None, None], wavelength_idler_range=[None, None], grid=None)[source]#

Bases: object

Simulate spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) for a crystal and pump laser.

The simulation is configured by a crystal (including its poling pattern) and a pump laser. A wavelength grid is constructed (either symmetric about the center wavelengths via dev_nm or from explicit signal/idler wavelength limits). The pump envelope and phase-matching function are evaluated on this grid to produce the joint spectral amplitude and intensity.

Parameters:

  • crystal (photonpairlab.crystal.Crystal) -- Crystal instance. A poling pattern must be generated (crystal.poling_pattern) before running the simulation.

  • laser (photonpairlab.laser.BaseLaser) -- Pump laser model providing the pump wavelength and spectral bandwidth.

  • wavelength_signal (float, optional) -- Signal center wavelength (m) used to compute the center phase mismatch. If None, defaults to 2 * laser.wavelength_pump (degenerate SPDC).

  • wavelength_idler (float, optional) -- Idler center wavelength (m) used to compute the center phase mismatch. If None, defaults to 2 * laser.wavelength_pump (degenerate SPDC).

  • wavelength_signal_range (list[float | None], optional) -- Legacy interface for specifying the signal wavelength range as [start, end] (m). If both values are None, the range is taken from grid. Prefer using grid.

  • wavelength_idler_range (list[float | None], optional) -- Legacy interface for specifying the idler wavelength range as [start, end] (m). If both values are None, the range is taken from grid. Prefer using grid.

  • grid (photonpairlab.spdc.spdc_config.SPDCGridConfig, optional) -- Wavelength grid configuration. If None, uses the default SPDCGridConfig.

initialize_parameters()[source]#

Precompute and cache center-dependent simulation parameters.

This method computes and stores: - the phase mismatch at the center wavelengths (via crystal.compute_phase_mismatch), - the center angular frequencies for pump/signal/idler, - the pump angular bandwidth, - the effective nonlinear coupling profile (from the poling pattern) and the

longitudinal coordinate for integration.

Raises:

ValueError -- If crystal.poling_pattern is None (poling not generated).

phase_matching_function(DeltaK)[source]#

Evaluate the phase-matching function on a (idler, signal) grid.

The phase-matching function is computed as a longitudinal integral over the crystal:

\[\Phi(\Delta k) = \int \xi_\mathrm{eff}(z) e^{-i \Delta k z} \, dz\]

where \(\xi_\mathrm{eff}(z)\) encodes the effective nonlinear coupling (including the poling pattern).

Parameters:

DeltaK (ndarray) -- Total phase mismatch array of shape (N_idler, N_signal) in rad/m.

Returns:

Complex phase-matching function evaluated on the grid with shape (N_idler, N_signal).

Return type:

ndarray

Notes

This implementation uses the trapezoidal rule for numerical integration.

pump_pulse_envelope(signal_wavelengths, idler_wavelengths)[source]#

Evaluate the (Gaussian) pump spectral envelope on a wavelength grid.

The pump envelope is evaluated in angular-frequency space as a function of the signal and idler angular frequencies, using the constraint \(\omega_s + \omega_i\) relative to the pump center frequency.

Parameters:

  • signal_wavelengths (ndarray) -- Signal wavelength axis of shape (N_signal,) in meters.

  • idler_wavelengths (ndarray) -- Idler wavelength axis of shape (N_idler,) in meters.

Returns:

Pump envelope on the 2D grid with shape (N_idler, N_signal).

Return type:

ndarray

run()[source]#

Run the SPDC simulation.

This method: 1. Builds wavelength axes from grid (via build_wavelength_axes()). 2. Computes phase mismatch on the wavelength grid. 3. Evaluates the pump envelope and phase-matching function. 4. Forms the joint spectral amplitude (JSA) and joint spectral intensity (JSI). 5. Returns an SPDCResults instance.

Returns:

Simulation results containing the pump envelope, phase-matching magnitude, joint spectral amplitude/intensity, and the signal/idler wavelength axes.

Return type:

SPDCResults

Notes

For interference calculations (e.g., HOM), it is usually preferable to store the complex JSA (including phase). If you need phase information downstream, set JSA=Amp instead of JSA=np.abs(Amp).
